description: Browse Project Gutenberg books ordered by downloads in the last 30 days at the source snapshot. Returns up to 32 titles with IDs, authors, languages, download counts, and is_readable. Filter by language, topic, MIME prefix or copyright status. Empty matches succeed with criteria and a notice; truncated results include executable search continuation. Use this for discovery — "what are the most popular classics in French?".

copyright.description: Any selected source copyright status: "true" copyrighted, "false" public domain in the USA, "null" unknown. Empty means all statuses; this is not worldwide legal clearance.

languages.description: Restrict to books in these languages (two-character ISO 639-1 codes). Example: ["en"] for English only, ["de", "fr"] for German or French. Omit for all languages.

limit.description: Requested number of books. Default 20; requests above 32 are capped locally at 32.

mime_type.description: Literal prefix of a format MIME key, such as "text/plain" or "text/html". Blank means unset.

topic.description: Filter by a subject or bookshelf keyword (case-insensitive phrase match). Example: "science fiction", "adventure", "detective". Applies on top of the language filter.

name: gutenberg_browse_popular

appliedLimit.description: Book limit applied locally, at most 32.

books.description: Top books by downloads in the last 30 days at the source snapshot, most popular first.

birth_year.description: Birth year, or null if unknown.

death_year.description: Death year, or null if unknown or still living.

download_count.description: Downloads in the last 30 days at the source snapshot — the popularity ranking basis.

has_plain_text.description: True for Text records with UTF-8 plain text; HTML-only editions can still have is_readable=true.

is_readable.description: True for non-Sound records with UTF-8 plain text or HTML supported by gutenberg_get_text.

continuation.description: Present only when more matching books exist.

arguments.description: Executable search arguments preserving all filters. Page 1 may repeat already shown books when the browse cap cuts a page.

author_year_end.description: At least one author has a birth or death year on or before this year (CE positive, BCE negative).

author_year_start.description: At least one author has a birth or death year on or after this year (CE positive, BCE negative).

copyright.description: Any selected source copyright status: "true" copyrighted, "false" public domain in the USA, "null" unknown. Empty means all statuses; this is not worldwide legal clearance.

ids.description: Restrict to these Gutenberg IDs, intersected with other filters. An empty list selects nothing; omit for unrestricted IDs.

languages.description: Any listed two-character ISO 639-1 language code; empty means all languages.

mime_type.description: Literal prefix of a format MIME key, such as "text/plain" or "text/html". Blank means unset.

page.description: One-indexed page of at most 32 matches. Pages beyond the result range are errors.

query.description: Every nonblank word must occur in the title or an author name, case-insensitively, as a literal substring. More than four words require the local mirror; live fallback rejects longer queries. Whitespace separates words.

sort.description: Popular orders by source-snapshot downloads in the last 30 days, with ID tie-breaks locally; ascending and descending order by Gutenberg ID.

topic.description: Case-insensitive phrase in a subject or bookshelf; blank means unset.

tool.description: Tool to call for the remaining matching books.

effectiveCriteria.description: Normalized browse criteria, including popular sort and first page.

author_year_start.description: At least one author has a birth or death year on or after this year (CE positive, BCE negative).

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `catalog_unavailable`: The Project Gutenberg catalog did not answer within the time this server allows for one browse. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Guidance for empty or capped results.

requestedLimit.description: Positive integral book limit requested before capping.

shown.description: Number of books returned in this response.

totalInCatalog.description: Total books matching the filter in the full catalog (useful for context — "top 20 of 60,000").

truncated.description: True when the catalog held more matches than were returned.

truncationCeiling.description: Downloads in the last 30 days at the source snapshot for the least-popular book shown; omitted books have at most this count.

title: Browse Popular Gutenberg Books
